headline: THE 2-ADIC COMMUTANT ORDER IS THE FLAT BLOCK AT q = 2.  Pass 656's commutant R = Z_2[S]/(S^2 - 4S) is the flat-block quadratic F^2 + 2F - (q^2 - 1) = 0 of Passes 479/488 under S = F + q + 1, which sends it to S^2 - 2qS = 0 with branches {0, 2q} and root gap 2q; at q = 2 this is exactly S^2 - 4S.  The governing conductor 4 = 2q|_{q=2} is the flat block's eigenvalue gap.  The periodic resolution over the order gives Ext^1(M0, M2q) = Ext^2(M0, M0) = Z_p/(2q), which is Z/4 at (p, q) = (2, 2), reproducing Pass 656's central invariants exactly, and Z/q for the odd-q analogue -- a direct prediction for the odd-prime version of that deformation theory.  Proved at the level of abstract orders and their homology; the S8 lattice-to-eigenspace identification is left as the testable consequence.

part_A_flat_block_quadratic.reading: The flat block satisfies its quadratic exactly at q = 3, 5, 7 with eigenvalues -1 +/- q; the eigenvalue gap is 2q.
part_A_flat_block_quadratic.source: Passes 479 and 488 (flat block of the zero section)

part_B_the_bridge.reading: Completing the square identifies the flat-block quadratic with the order Z[S]/(S(S - 2q)); the q = 2 member is exactly the S8 commutant of Pass 641/656, and its conductor 4 is the eigenvalue gap 2q at q = 2.

part_C_homology.prediction: the ODD-q flat-block order has Ext^1 = Ext^2 = Z/q, since 2 is a unit and v_q(2q) = 1 -- the direct odd-prime analogue of Pass 656, testable by the GAP deformation machinery.
part_C_homology.resolution: the periodic resolution ... -> O -(S-2q)-> O -S-> O -> M0; S acts as the scalar 2q on M2q, so Ext^1 = M2q/(2q) and Ext^2 = M0/(2q)

part_D_boundary.connection: This places the entire 2-adic deformation frontier (641, 651, 656, 657) as the q = 2 fiber of the flat-block quadratic proved for odd q in Passes 479 and 488, and identifies its governing conductor 4 as the flat block's eigenvalue gap.
part_D_boundary.not_proved: That the S8 characteristic lattices M0, M4 ARE the +/-q eigenspaces of the flat block.  That module-level identification needs the GAP lattice construction (Passes 641, 656) and is left as the testable consequence; the exact match of the minimal polynomial and of Ext = Z/4 on the shared W(3,3)/E8 substrate is the evidence.
part_D_boundary.proved: The abstract orders coincide: S = F + q + 1 carries the flat-block quadratic to S(S - 2q), whose q = 2 member is Pass 656's commutant, and whose conductor 2q gives Ext = Z_p/(2q), = Z/4 at (2,2).
